description: Estimate solar panel daily and yearly energy output by location and system size. Use for solar installation sizing. Inputs: kW capacity, latitude, panel orientation, shading %. Returns kWh/day and kWh/year. See list_bundles for related 'energie' calculators.

area_m2.description: Panel surface area in m2 (optional, informational)

hours_sun_per_day.description: Average peak sun hours per day (default 4)

panel_watt_peak.description: Total peak power of the installation in Watts (Wp)

name: calculate_solar_panel_output

formula.description: Human-readable formula or method used (e.g. "I=P·r·t", "Magnus formula").

reference_url.description: Link to a calcul2 page documenting the calculation in detail.

result.description: Computed result. Object whose fields depend on the tool (e.g. {tax, marginal_rate, brackets} for tax tools, {volume_l, gallons} for volume tools).

source.description: Authoritative source for the rule or formula (e.g. "Article 197 CGI", "NF DTU 21").

title: Calculate Solar Panel Output
